13. (Currently amended) A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __and wherein the contact elements are electrically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

14. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body __that surrounds at least a portion of the flexible tube__.

15. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __via mechanical fasteners or snap-fit connections__.

16. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the sheathing body __and is thermally coupled to the flexible tube__.

17. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design __comprising an inner thermal layer and an outer protective layer__.

18. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube.

19. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube __and is in direct contact with the flexible tube material__.

24. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material __having a tensile strength of at least 5 MPa__.

25. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater __comprising a resistive wire or film element__.

27. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __and wherein each contact element is a contact surface__.

28. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __in a radial direction__.

29. (Currently amended) A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __and wherein the contact elements are electrically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

30. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein each contact element is a contact surface provided within the second portion __and extends parallel to the longitudinal axis__.

31. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __in a radial direction__.
